name: jianfeidazi-miniprogram
description: 掉秤搭搭 微信小程序前端（uni-app 构建，目标端仅 mp-weixin）

scripts.build:h5:local: VITE_H5_BASE=/ uni build --mode test -p h5 && rm -rf dist/build/h5/static && cp -r static dist/build/h5/static
scripts.build:h5:test: UNI_H5_BASE=/test-h5/ VITE_H5_BASE=/test-h5/ uni build --mode test -p h5 && rm -rf dist/build/h5/static && cp -r static dist/build/h5/static
scripts.build:h5:prod: UNI_H5_BASE=/h5/ VITE_H5_BASE=/h5/ uni build --mode production -p h5 && rm -rf dist/build/h5/static && cp -r static dist/build/h5/static
scripts.build:mp-weixin:test: uni build --mode test -p mp-weixin && mkdir -p dist/build/mp-weixin/static && cp -r static/* dist/build/mp-weixin/static/ && rm -rf dist/build/mp-weixin/custom-tab-bar && mkdir -p dist/build/mp-weixin/custom-tab-bar && cp src/custom-tab-bar/index.{js,json,wxml,wxss} dist/build/mp-weixin/custom-tab-bar/
scripts.build:mp-weixin:prod: uni build --mode production -p mp-weixin && mkdir -p dist/build/mp-weixin/static && cp -r static/* dist/build/mp-weixin/static/ && rm -rf dist/build/mp-weixin/custom-tab-bar && mkdir -p dist/build/mp-weixin/custom-tab-bar && cp src/custom-tab-bar/index.{js,json,wxml,wxss} dist/build/mp-weixin/custom-tab-bar/
